records.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: CB1, a transparent hand-painted front-cover texture for the Breachline lore codex interface.
Create ONE front cover, directly overhead in an exact orthographic plan view. Portrait PNG canvas 1024 x 1536. The flat rectangular cover has a precise 3:4 width-to-height proportion, approximately 1020 x 1360 pixels, centred on the canvas, with transparent space mainly above and below and a tiny antialiased safety margin at left and right. All four sides straight and parallel to the image borders. Show only the flat exterior front face, not a perspective book or a page block.
A fine scholar's book carried for years by a historian of the Lantern Conclave in Ambrel: deep blue-teal leather over boards, matte worn smooth, slightly darker at handholds and rubbed paler along edges and corners. Visible but quiet oil/acrylic brushwork, carefully painted believable material, precise rather than noisy detail. Heavy and loved, restrained and usable.
A blind-tooled double border with a thin worn gold line just inside; four simple small worn brass corner caps; shallow straight hinge groove down the LEFT edge. Upper middle has a modest recessed rectangular title panel of paler desaturated teal leather, entirely blank and smooth.
Required emblem reference: attached image is the actual current Gnosis/Conclave insignia. Preserve its exact eye-shaped central mark with round pupil, circular ring and short radial ticks, translating the silver design into understated old gold tooling. Place one medium-sized insignia in the cover centre below the blank title panel. Use the insignia design, not a freestanding metal badge, and invent no replacement star or extra symbols.
Soft even neutral illumination across the plane. No directional lighting, no cast shadows, no glow, no vignetting on the transparent surround. Real alpha transparency outside the cover, including antialiased edges; do not paint checkerboard, paper, table or any backdrop.
No title, text, letters, numbers, runes, signature, watermark, clasp, hands, scenery, pages or extra objects. Not a photo, 3D render, vector icon, cartoon, carved relic or ornate magic tome. The game will add all lettering, perspective, shadows and lighting.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: CB2, transparent INSIDE front-cover texture for Breachline's lore codex.
The attached CB1 is the material, wear, size and outline master. Paint the reverse/inside face of that same board. Preserve its exact flat rectangular 3:4 cover proportions, outline, deep blue-teal leather colour and worn old-gold finish. Straight overhead orthographic view, no tilt, side faces, perspective or cast shadow. Requested portrait canvas 1024 x 1536 with cover filling width and centred transparent space above and below.
The hinge is on the RIGHT edge now. Leather folds over all four edges as a narrow border about one twentieth of the cover width, lightly rubbed and edged with a fine gold line. Fill the inset with beautiful low-contrast hand-marbled endpaper in quiet teal, amber and cream. Delicate flowing marbling, not loud high-contrast swirls. The inside does not show the exterior's brass corner caps or big gold emblem.
In the upper middle place a small warm-ivory pasted rectangular bookplate with a restrained engraved sepia border and a COMPLETELY BLANK smooth centre. Approximate bookplate width half the board width, height one sixth the board height. No words, no fictitious writing, no emblem in the bookplate.
Traditional oil and acrylic fantasy paint, quiet brushwork, matte paper and leather, carefully selected detail. Even neutral light, no directional lamp shading. Real alpha transparency outside the board, clean antialiased boundary, no background/checkerboard/table/scene. No text, letters, numbers, runes, labels, signature, watermark, hands, loose pages, clasp or additional objects. This is one stationary interface piece, not an open book.
